posts.name: Birendra paul
posts.cooked:
This is not a problem.
By default, newer systems automatically generate an ed25519 key pair instead of RSA.
The ed25519 key is actually more secure and is recommended over RSA.

The course portal shows ssh-rsa only as an example, not a strict requirement.

Just make sure you paste the public key(.pub), not the private key.
